7cc09576d65f843347dd3a91048b42e560bdbf4e.missing: Representation of the emergency action instruction for passengers (the action to take in an emergency).
7cc09576d65f843347dd3a91048b42e560bdbf4e.why: The requirement (IMO-078 clause 8.3.3.3.3.6-.7) explicitly states that passengers shall be instructed in the use of personal survival equipment **and the action to take in an emergency**. The current SHACL model only validates the boolean property nltl:personalSurvivalEquipmentInstructionCompleted. No property or constraint captures the “emergency action” aspect.
